newsitem.title: USA: US Sept T-bonds continue to rally in orderly trade.
newsitem.headline: US Sept T-bonds continue to rally in orderly trade.

text.p: July 16 - U.S. debt futures continued to rally in orderly afternoon trade. Four large dealers each bought 1,000 Sept T-bonds, which helped push the contract to 114-27/32. Resistance is at 115-02/32 to 115-03/32. Traders noted talk of heavy extension and principal buying. ((Chicago derivatives desk (312)408-8750))
